articles.title: Reset your password
articles.body: Forgot your password? Use the reset link sent to your email. If the link expired or your account is locked, request a new reset.

articles.title: Understanding charges on your card
articles.body: Why you see a pending or duplicate charge on your card, billing cycles and plan renewal explained.

articles.title: How refunds and returns work
articles.body: Request a refund or return an order. Money goes back to the original payment method once the return arrives.

articles.title: Track your package
articles.body: Check delivery tracking and shipping status, what to do when a package is late.

articles.title: Two-factor authentication codes
articles.body: Set up two factor authentication, what to do if the verification code does not arrive on your phone.

articles.title: Download invoices and receipts
articles.body: Find and download a pdf invoice or receipt for tax records in billing settings.

articles.title: Speed up your device
articles.body: Free storage space, close background tasks and keep handsets cool for smoother operation of mobile software.

macros.name: Password reset steps
macros.body: Reset password: use the Forgot password link, check the email spam folder for the reset link, links expire quickly. If your account is locked wait before trying again.

macros.name: Duplicate charge
macros.body: Billing charge check: we will review the card charge, a duplicate or twice charge pending authorization usually drops off. We will refund a confirmed duplicate.

macros.name: Refund process
macros.body: Refund request: return the order, once received the money is refunded to the original payment method.

macros.name: Delayed shipping
macros.body: Shipping delay: the package tracking shows delivery status; late deliveries are traced with the carrier and we will follow up.

macros.name: Address change
macros.body: Address change: update the delivery address before the order ships; wrong or moved address can be changed on the order page.

macros.name: Cancellation
macros.body: Cancel subscription: close the account from settings, the plan stops at the end of the billing period.

macros.name: 2FA recovery
macros.body: Verification code help: authentication code sent to your phone; lost phone requires identity verification to login.

macros.name: App crash triage
macros.body: App crash: update to the latest version, error on launch freezes are fixed by reinstalling. Send us the error details.

macros.name: Invoice download
macros.body: Invoice and receipt: download the pdf invoice from billing settings; tax receipts are available for every charge.

macros.name: Integration setup
macros.body: Setup guide: connect the integration under settings, configure the dashboard options step by step.
